title: Dose Log: Three Screens Down to One, Save Always Visible | vitalii.no
description:
Logging a single meal used to mean scrolling past base values, a correction table and weight notes before even reaching the food picker — then scrolling further still to find the save button once the dose was calculated. For a two-minute task done several times a day, that added up to real friction.

The calculator page was restructured into three compact steps on one scroll: base values collapse into a single confirmed line, food choice becomes three equal tiles with the carb total shown right in the heading, and the dose card surfaces any warning before the breakdown underneath it. A sticky bottom bar now carries the calculated dose and a Save to the journal button no matter how far down the page you've scrolled.

A full meal log now fits in one scroll instead of three, and the save button is always visible instead of requiring a scroll back up.
